s0201.literal: Moreover, to match a woman who has lost chastity with a man who has merit differs again from the meaning in the ancients' saying, 'to take a woman who has lost chastity as one's mate is itself loss of chastity.'
s0201.idiomatic: Moreover, to match a woman who has lost chastity with a man who has merit differs again from the meaning in the ancients' saying, 'to take a woman who has lost chastity as one's mate is itself loss of chastity.'

s0202.literal: From now on, whenever treasonous ministers have slaves and property confiscated, their wives and children need not be punished.
s0202.idiomatic: From now on, whenever treasonous ministers have slaves and property confiscated, their wives and children need not be punished.

s0203.literal: Those who warrant capital punishment shall be executed together with their families, and need not be transferred to others, so that women may generally preserve chastity.
s0203.idiomatic: Those who warrant capital punishment shall be executed together with their families, and need not be transferred to others, so that women may generally preserve chastity.

s0204.literal: Please establish this as a statute.
s0204.idiomatic: Please establish this as a statute.

s0205.literal: " On renzi day sea transport grain reached the capital, totaling one million four hundred nine thousand one hundred thirty shi.
s0205.idiomatic: " On renzi day sea transport grain reached the capital, totaling 1,409,130 shi.

s0207.literal: A plaque was granted to the Qiyang Academy in Fengxiang Prefecture.
s0207.idiomatic: A plaque was granted to the Qiyang Academy in Fengxiang Prefecture.

s0208.literal: The academy sacrifices to Duke Wenxian of Zhou; officials were also ordered to establish academy posts, with spring and autumn libation sacrifices following the rites of Confucius temples.
s0208.idiomatic: The academy sacrifices to Duke Wenxian of Zhou; officials were also ordered to establish academy posts, with spring and autumn libation sacrifices following the rites of Confucius temples.

s0209.literal: Mingzong sent Ministry of Personnel minister Bierqiebuhua back to the capital.
s0209.idiomatic: Mingzong sent Ministry of Personnel minister Bierqiebuhua back to the capital.

s0210.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to assemble senior ministers to deliberate on policies for relieving famine.
s0210.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to assemble senior ministers to deliberate on policies for relieving famine.

s0211.literal: At the time over a hundred thousand displaced persons in Shaanxi, Hedong, Yannan, Hebei, and Henan routes, from Song and Ru to Huainan, lay dead one upon another; officials of each prefecture and county were ordered to relieve them as circumstances permitted.
s0211.idiomatic: At the time over 100,000 displaced persons in Shaanxi, Hedong, Yannan, Hebei, and Henan routes, from Song and Ru to Huainan, lay dead one upon another; officials of each prefecture and county were ordered to relieve them as circumstances permitted.

s0212.literal: Relay stations in Shunyuan, Si, and Bozhou, because of warfare, had many horses weak and dead and relay households impoverished; relevant offices were ordered to purchase horses to replace them.
s0212.idiomatic: Relay stations in Shunyuan, Si, and Bozhou, because of warfare, had many horses weak and dead and relay households impoverished; relevant offices were ordered to purchase horses to replace them.

s0213.literal: In Yidu, Ju and Mi prefectures there was spring flooding; in summer drought and locusts; thirty-one thousand four hundred famine households received one month's relief grain.
s0213.idiomatic: In Yidu, Ju and Mi prefectures there was spring flooding; in summer drought and locusts; 31,400 famine households received 1 month's relief grain.

s0214.literal: The various farm colonies in Yan'an, Shaanxi, because of drought, were exempted from one thousand nine hundred seventy shi of previously overdue grain.
s0214.idiomatic: The various farm colonies in Yan'an, Shaanxi, because of drought, were exempted from 1,970 shi of previously overdue grain.

s0215.literal: The Changguo, Jimin, Fengshan, and other offices of Yongping Colonization Bureau were exempted from this year's rent on account of locusts and flood.
s0215.idiomatic: The Changguo, Jimin, Fengshan, and other offices of Yongping Colonization Bureau were exempted from this year's rent on account of locusts and flood.

s0216.literal: Bianliang had locusts; Weihui had silkworm disaster; Xia Prefecture drought; Huaidong routes and Xuzhou and Pizhou in Guide Prefecture great flood.
s0216.idiomatic: Bianliang had locusts; Weihui had silkworm disaster; Xia Prefecture drought; Huaidong routes and Xuzhou and Pizhou in Guide Prefecture great flood.

s0217.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on bingchen new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
s0217.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on bingchen new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.

s0218.literal: On dingsi day the court halted at the Thirty-li Inn of Shangdu.
s0218.idiomatic: On dingsi day the court halted at the Thirty-li Inn of Shangdu.

s0219.literal: Zongren Guard colony fields suffered great flood, ruining two hundred sixty qing of fields.
s0219.idiomatic: Zongren Guard colony fields suffered great flood, ruining 260 qing of fields.

s0220.literal: On wuwu day, in Dong'an, Jizhou, Yongqing, Yijin, and Lu County of Dadu, spring and summer drought — wheat seedlings withered;
s0220.idiomatic: On wuwu day, in Dong'an, Jizhou, Yongqing, Yijin, and Lu County of Dadu, spring and summer drought — wheat seedlings withered;

s0221.literal: on renzi day of the sixth month it rained, and only on this day did it stop — all were flood disasters.
s0221.idiomatic: on renzi day of the sixth month it rained, and only on this day did it stop — all were flood disasters.

s0222.literal: On jiwei day the relocation law was revised: all who ought to be relocated, according to the distance of residence, were moved a thousand li; those on the road who encountered amnesty were all permitted to return;
s0222.idiomatic: On jiwei day the relocation law was revised: all who ought to be relocated, according to the distance of residence, were moved 1,000 li; those on the road who encountered amnesty were all permitted to return;

s0223.literal: if incorrigible and reoffending, they were relocated to barren lands within the province; after ten years without offense they were gradually transferred back;
s0223.idiomatic: if incorrigible and reoffending, they were relocated to barren lands within the province; after 10 years without offense they were gradually transferred back;

s0224.literal: when relocated persons died, wives and children were permitted to return to native places.
s0224.idiomatic: when relocated persons died, wives and children were permitted to return to native places.

s0225.literal: This was established as a statute.
s0225.idiomatic: This was established as a statute.

s0226.literal: Commercial taxes on monks and Daoists in the capital were levied.
s0226.idiomatic: Commercial taxes on monks and Daoists in the capital were levied.

s0227.literal: On guihai day Venus crossed the sky.
s0227.idiomatic: On guihai day Venus crossed the sky.

s0228.literal: On bingzi day the Emperor received the crown prince's seal.
s0228.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Emperor received the crown prince's seal.

s0229.literal: On xinsi day six thousand troops of the various guards were mobilized to repair the capital.
s0229.idiomatic: On xinsi day 6,000 troops of the various guards were mobilized to repair the capital.

s0230.literal: In Yangqu County, Jin Prefecture, hail fell, the largest like hen's eggs.
s0230.idiomatic: In Yangqu County, Jin Prefecture, hail fell, the largest like hen's eggs.

s0231.literal: For darughachis of princes' fiefs, men of the princely household aged twenty-five and above, knowledgeable in governance, honest and without offense, were to be selected; if there was improper selection, punishment would extend to the princely tutor.
s0231.idiomatic: For darughachis of princes' fiefs, men of the princely household aged 25 and above, knowledgeable in governance, honest and without offense, were to be selected; if there was improper selection, punishment would extend to the princely tutor.

s0232.literal: Envoys were dispatched with upper libation vessels, preserved mutton, and ten ingots of notes to the National University at Dadu to assist the mid-autumn upper ding libation sacrifice.
s0232.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched with upper libation vessels, preserved mutton, and 10 ingots of notes to the National University at Dadu to assist the mid-autumn upper ding libation sacrifice.

s0233.literal: Because Haining Prefecture, Yancheng, and Shanyang counties in Huai'an had flood last year, this year's field rent was remitted.
s0233.idiomatic: Because Haining Prefecture, Yancheng, and Shanyang counties in Huai'an had flood last year, this year's field rent was remitted.

s0234.literal: Attached counties in Zhending, Hejian, Bianliang, Yongping, Huai'an, Daning, and Luzhou, and Gaizhou in Liaoyang, had locusts.
s0234.idiomatic: Attached counties in Zhending, Hejian, Bianliang, Yongping, Huai'an, Daning, and Luzhou, and Gaizhou in Liaoyang, had locusts.

s0235.literal: Eighth month, on yiyou new moon, Mingzong halted at Wanghuchadu.
s0235.idiomatic: Eighth month, on yiyou new moon, Mingzong halted at Wanghuchadu.

s0236.literal: On bingxu day the Emperor entered to have audience; Mingzong feasted the Emperor, princes, and ministers at the traveling hall.
s0236.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Emperor entered to have audience; Mingzong feasted the Emperor, princes, and ministers at the traveling hall.

s0237.literal: On gengyin day Mingzong died; the Emperor entered to mourn and wept to exhaustion.
s0237.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mingzong died; the Emperor entered to mourn and wept to exhaustion.

s0238.literal: Yan Temür, by Mingzong's final command, presented the imperial seal to the Emperor, then returned.
s0238.idiomatic: Yan Temür, by Mingzong's final command, presented the imperial seal to the Emperor, then returned.

s0239.literal: On renchen day the court halted at Boluochahan; Bayan was made central secretariat left chancellor, retaining his former post as grand preceptor;
s0239.idiomatic: On renchen day the court halted at Boluochahan; Bayan was made central secretariat left chancellor, retaining his former post as grand preceptor;

s0240.literal: Qincha Tai, Arslan Qaya, and Zhao Shiyan were all made central secretariat grand councillors;
s0240.idiomatic: Qincha Tai, Arslan Qaya, and Zhao Shiyan were all made central secretariat grand councillors;

s0241.literal: Gansu Branch Secretariat grand councillor Dorji was made central secretariat right vice chancellor;
s0241.idiomatic: Gansu Branch Secretariat grand councillor Dorji was made central secretariat right vice chancellor;

s0242.literal: central secretariat deliberator Arong and crown prince household vice director Zhao Shi'an were both made central secretariat associate administrators;
s0242.idiomatic: central secretariat deliberator Arong and crown prince household vice director Zhao Shi'an were both made central secretariat associate administrators;

s0243.literal: former right chancellor Tash Temür, privy council administrator Temür Buhua, and Shangdu defender Temür Toq were all made censor-in-chief.
s0243.idiomatic: former right chancellor Tash Temür, privy council administrator Temür Buhua, and Shangdu defender Temür Toq were all made censor-in-chief.

s0244.literal: On guisi day the Emperor reached Shangdu.
s0244.idiomatic: On guisi day the Emperor reached Shangdu.

s0245.literal: On yiwei day Boluo and others, officials guarding the late emperor's tomb mound and censor-in-chief, were granted ingots of notes in graded amounts.
s0245.idiomatic: On yiwei day Boluo and others, officials guarding the late emperor's tomb mound and censor-in-chief, were granted ingots of notes in graded amounts.

s0246.literal: Counterfeit Sichuan salt and tea certificates were burned.
s0246.idiomatic: Counterfeit Sichuan salt and tea certificates were burned.

s0247.literal: On bingshen day supervising censor Xu Yi said: "The realm cannot be without a ruler for a single day; the imperial regalia cannot long remain vacant.
s0247.idiomatic: On bingshen day supervising censor Xu Yi said: "The realm cannot be without a ruler for a single day; the imperial regalia cannot long remain vacant.

s0248.literal: The late emperor abandoned the multitude several days ago; We humbly hope Your Majesty will soon take the imperial throne, to settle the hearts of the hundred millions — truly a boundless blessing for the altars of state.
s0248.idiomatic: The late emperor abandoned the multitude several days ago; We humbly hope Your Majesty will soon take the imperial throne, to settle the hearts of the hundred millions — truly a boundless blessing for the altars of state.

s0249.literal: " Prince Hulachu was banished to Hainan.
s0249.idiomatic: " Prince Hulachu was banished to Hainan.

s0250.literal: On dingyou day Arong and Zhao Shi'an were ordered to direct Transmission Court affairs; all relay-dispatch matters must be reported and approved before dispatch.
s0250.idiomatic: On dingyou day Arong and Zhao Shi'an were ordered to direct Transmission Court affairs; all relay-dispatch matters must be reported and approved before dispatch.

s0251.literal: On wuxu day Nangjiatai of Sichuan, for reviling the imperial carriage, was condemned for great disrespect and executed in the marketplace.
s0251.idiomatic: On wuxu day Nangjiatai of Sichuan, for reviling the imperial carriage, was condemned for great disrespect and executed in the marketplace.

s0252.literal: On jihai day the Emperor again took the throne at the Great Peace Pavilion of Shangdu, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and issued an edict, saying:
s0252.idiomatic: On jihai day the Emperor again took the throne at the Great Peace Pavilion of Shangdu, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and issued an edict, saying:

s0253.literal: Greatly do We reflect that formerly Heaven opened Our Founding Emperor to begin the imperial enterprise, and successive sages have carried it on.
s0253.idiomatic: Greatly do We reflect that formerly Heaven opened Our Founding Emperor to begin the imperial enterprise, and successive sages have carried it on.

s0254.literal: Emperor Shizu, having unified the realm, established a crown prince; but Our Illustrious Father Heaven did not grant years; Chengzong entered in succession for barely more than ten years.
s0254.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu, having unified the realm, established a crown prince; but Our Illustrious Father Heaven did not grant years; Chengzong entered in succession for barely more than 10 years.

s0255.literal: Our imperial father Wuzong returned to receive the Great Foundation, fully obtaining Heaven's heart; his intent was without selfishness — he had the Benevolent Temple reside in the Eastern Palace and thereupon succeeded to the imperial throne.
s0255.idiomatic: Our imperial father Wuzong returned to receive the Great Foundation, fully obtaining Heaven's heart; his intent was without selfishness — he had the Benevolent Temple reside in the Eastern Palace and thereupon succeeded to the imperial throne.

s0256.literal: Hardly had Yingzong ascended when disaster cut down Our house.
s0256.idiomatic: Hardly had Yingzong ascended when disaster cut down Our house.

s0257.literal: The Jin residence broke covenant and raised rebellion, seized the imperial regalia; Heaven showed reproof and he finally perished.
s0257.idiomatic: The Jin residence broke covenant and raised rebellion, seized the imperial regalia; Heaven showed reproof and he finally perished.

s0258.literal: Thereupon imperial kinsmen and old ministers joined in counsel to raise righteous action, set right names to punish crime — measured against the succession line, it fell to Our slight person.
s0258.idiomatic: Thereupon imperial kinsmen and old ministers joined in counsel to raise righteous action, set right names to punish crime — measured against the succession line, it fell to Our slight person.

s0259.literal: We recalled Our elder brother wandering in the northern desert — by virtue and by seniority the mandate ought to return to him; We firmly resisted the multitude's pleas, even to a fourth time.
s0259.idiomatic: We recalled Our elder brother wandering in the northern desert — by virtue and by seniority the mandate ought to return to him; We firmly resisted the multitude's pleas, even to a fourth time.

s0260.literal: They said that in times of hardship, if the Heavenly throne long remained vacant the multitude's resolve would not be firm and the great enterprise might be ruined.
s0260.idiomatic: They said that in times of hardship, if the Heavenly throne long remained vacant the multitude's resolve would not be firm and the great enterprise might be ruined.

s0261.literal: Though We acceded to the request and assumed rule, holding to Our original resolve without change — hence the edict of firm yielding was first issued, yet envoys to welcome him had already been dispatched.
s0261.idiomatic: Though We acceded to the request and assumed rule, holding to Our original resolve without change — hence the edict of firm yielding was first issued, yet envoys to welcome him had already been dispatched.

s0262.literal: Soon Alaqtenashiri and Yan Temür were ordered to bear the imperial seal and tally, to welcome him from afar on the road.
s0262.idiomatic: Soon Alaqtenashiri and Yan Temür were ordered to bear the imperial seal and tally, to welcome him from afar on the road.

s0263.literal: On the day he received the seal and acceded, he immediately dispatched envoys to confer on Us the crown prince's seal.
s0263.idiomatic: On the day he received the seal and acceded, he immediately dispatched envoys to confer on Us the crown prince's seal.

s0264.literal: We fortunately shed heavy burdens and truly obtained Our long-held heart; thereupon We led ministers and people north to welcome the imperial carriage.
s0264.idiomatic: We fortunately shed heavy burdens and truly obtained Our long-held heart; thereupon We led ministers and people north to welcome the imperial carriage.

s0265.literal: But the late emperor traversed mountains and rivers, exposed to frost and dew; the road was vast and remote — from spring to autumn, bearing hardship over years, gazing toward the capital with growing grief; carelessly attending to his health, he repeatedly violated proper regimen.
s0265.idiomatic: But the late emperor traversed mountains and rivers, exposed to frost and dew; the road was vast and remote — from spring to autumn, bearing hardship over years, gazing toward the capital with growing grief; carelessly attending to his health, he repeatedly violated proper regimen.

s0266.literal: Messengers came and went, one visible to the other on the roads; each side longed to meet, urgency pressing in the breast.
s0266.idiomatic: Messengers came and went, one visible to the other on the roads; each side longed to meet, urgency pressing in the breast.

s0267.literal: On the first day of the eighth month the imperial carriage halted at Wanghuchadu; We rejoiced that meeting was near and advanced alone by forced marches; at the moment of meeting, grief and joy mingled.
s0267.idiomatic: On the 1st day of the eighth month the imperial carriage halted at Wanghuchadu; We rejoiced that meeting was near and advanced alone by forced marches; at the moment of meeting, grief and joy mingled.

s0268.literal: How, within several days, the palace carriage should cease — the state in many troubles, suddenly come to this!
s0268.idiomatic: How, within several days, the palace carriage should cease — the state in many troubles, suddenly come to this!

s0269.literal: Thinking of it pierces the heart — day succeeds night in sorrow.
s0269.idiomatic: Thinking of it pierces the heart — day succeeds night in sorrow.

s0270.literal: Princes and ministers held that the loftiness of the ancestral foundation and the weight of the late emperor's entrustment — where Heaven's mandate lies — truly could not be violated; they requested We immediately take correct position to settle the nine domains.
s0270.idiomatic: Princes and ministers held that the loftiness of the ancestral foundation and the weight of the late emperor's entrustment — where Heaven's mandate lies — truly could not be violated; they requested We immediately take correct position to settle the nine domains.

s0271.literal: We, the late emperor having just abandoned Us, how could We bear crushing grief;
s0271.idiomatic: We, the late emperor having just abandoned Us, how could We bear crushing grief;

s0272.literal: bearing grief We declined, yet their earnest pleas grew only firmer; holding to propriety We prostrated at the gate for three days — all for the altars of state's great design — and on the fifteenth day of the eighth month took the imperial throne at Shangdu; a general amnesty throughout the realm may be proclaimed; before dawn on the fifteenth day of the eighth month of the second year of Tianli, crimes whether light or heavy are alike remitted and abolished.
s0272.idiomatic: bearing grief We declined, yet their earnest pleas grew only firmer; holding to propriety We prostrated at the gate for 3 days — all for the altars of state's great design — and on the 15th day of the eighth month took the imperial throne at Shangdu; a general amnesty throughout the realm may be proclaimed; before dawn on the 15th day of the eighth month of the second year of Tianli, crimes whether light or heavy are alike remitted and abolished.

s0274.literal: After pacification, nothing is more urgent than giving the people rest;
s0274.idiomatic: After pacification, nothing is more urgent than giving the people rest;

s0275.literal: in the way of great transformation, nothing is greater than making the people know righteousness.
s0275.idiomatic: in the way of great transformation, nothing is greater than making the people know righteousness.

s0276.literal: Also you great and small ministers within and without — each exhaust your hearts to accord with Our intent.
s0276.idiomatic: Also you great and small ministers within and without — each exhaust your hearts to accord with Our intent.

s0277.literal: On gengzi day Arong and Zhao Shi'an were ordered to supervise construction of Longxiang Jiqing Temple at Jiankang.
s0277.idiomatic: On gengzi day Arong and Zhao Shi'an were ordered to supervise construction of Longxiang Jiqing Temple at Jiankang.

s0278.literal: On xinchou day Ninghui Temple was established to manage Mingzong's palace division affairs.
s0278.idiomatic: On xinchou day Ninghui Temple was established to manage Mingzong's palace division affairs.

s0279.literal: On renyin day ten thousand ingots of notes and two thousand bolts of silks were supplied for the expenses of Mingzong's empress Babusha.
s0279.idiomatic: On renyin day 10,000 ingots of notes and 2,000 bolts of silks were supplied for the expenses of Mingzong's empress Babusha.

s0280.literal: The Kuizhang Pavilion Academician Institute was promoted to rank 2a; the Registry Clerk post was renamed the Jade Collection Office, rank 6a.
s0280.idiomatic: The Kuizhang Pavilion Academician Institute was promoted to rank 2a; the Registry Clerk post was renamed the Jade Collection Office, rank 6a.

s0281.literal: On guimao day the Emperor visited the tent hall where Shizu performed imperial rites and conducted purification sacrifice.
s0281.idiomatic: On guimao day the Emperor visited the tent hall where Shizu performed imperial rites and conducted purification sacrifice.

s0282.literal: An edict forbade that those delivering princely and imperial son-in-law bounty gifts accept gold and silks — violators were tried as embezzlement;
s0282.idiomatic: An edict forbade that those delivering princely and imperial son-in-law bounty gifts accept gold and silks — violators were tried as embezzlement;

s0283.literal: those giving clothing or horses as gifts were permitted.
s0283.idiomatic: those giving clothing or horses as gifts were permitted.

s0284.literal: Taoist priests Miao Daoyi and Wu Quanjie were dispatched to perform jiao rites at the capital; Mao Yingyuan sacrificed to the Dunjia Spirit at South Screen Mountain of Shangdu and West Mountain of Dadu.
s0284.idiomatic: Taoist priests Miao Daoyi and Wu Quanjie were dispatched to perform jiao rites at the capital; Mao Yingyuan sacrificed to the Dunjia Spirit at South Screen Mountain of Shangdu and West Mountain of Dadu.

s0285.literal: On jiachen day the Directorate of Astronomy and Muslim Directorate of Astronomy were ordered to observe the comet.
s0285.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Directorate of Astronomy and Muslim Directorate of Astronomy were ordered to observe the comet.

s0286.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "By ancestral precedent, at the beginning of accession bounty must be granted to princes and the hundred officials.
s0286.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "By ancestral precedent, at the beginning of accession bounty must be granted to princes and the hundred officials.

s0287.literal: Recently because of warfare expenses are insufficient; we request following Wuzong's regulation — all gold and silver of five ingots and above reduced by one third; below five ingots given in full; also taking seven parts as standard, two parts paid in notes at current value.
s0287.idiomatic: Recently because of warfare expenses are insufficient; we request following Wuzong's regulation — all gold and silver of 5 ingots and above reduced by one third; below 5 ingots given in full; also taking 7 parts as standard, 2 parts paid in notes at current value.

s0289.literal: Qincha Tai was dispatched first to return to the capital to manage government affairs;
s0289.idiomatic: Qincha Tai was dispatched first to return to the capital to manage government affairs;

s0290.literal: Yan Temür and Arong remained at Shangdu to supervise distribution of bounty gold and silks.
s0290.idiomatic: Yan Temür and Arong remained at Shangdu to supervise distribution of bounty gold and silks.

s0291.literal: Two hundred guard soldiers of Renzong's and Yingzong's latent residences were sent back to Dadu to serve on palace watch.
s0291.idiomatic: 200 guard soldiers of Renzong's and Yingzong's latent residences were sent back to Dadu to serve on palace watch.

s0292.literal: On yisi day the Art and Literature Court was established, rank 3b, subordinate to Kuizhang Pavilion Academician Institute;
s0292.idiomatic: On yisi day the Art and Literature Court was established, rank 3b, subordinate to Kuizhang Pavilion Academician Institute;

s0293.literal: the Art Forest Storehouse and Guangcheng Bureau were also established, all subordinate to the Art and Literature Court.
s0293.idiomatic: the Art Forest Storehouse and Guangcheng Bureau were also established, all subordinate to the Art and Literature Court.

s0294.literal: Censorate vice commissioner-in-chief Shi Weiliang was granted fifty qing of land in Pei County.
s0294.idiomatic: Censorate vice commissioner-in-chief Shi Weiliang was granted 50 qing of land in Pei County.

s0295.literal: Troops of the various guards were mobilized to dredge the Tonghui Canal.
s0295.idiomatic: Troops of the various guards were mobilized to dredge the Tonghui Canal.

s0296.literal: On bingzi day, from gengzi to this day, fog by day and clear by night.
s0296.idiomatic: On bingzi day, from gengzi to this day, fog by day and clear by night.

s0297.literal: Yan Nashiri was enfeoffed Prince of Lia; the seal of the former Prince of Lia Toqto was granted to him.
s0297.idiomatic: Yan Nashiri was enfeoffed Prince of Lia; the seal of the former Prince of Lia Toqto was granted to him.

s0298.literal: Fifty thousand shi of official grain was released for relief sale to the capital's poor.
s0298.idiomatic: 50,000 shi of official grain was released for relief sale to the capital's poor.

s0299.literal: On dingwei day Mazhaertai was made Shangdu defender.
s0299.idiomatic: On dingwei day Mazhaertai was made Shangdu defender.

s0300.literal: Formerly Mazhaertai had been Shaanxi Branch Censorate attendant censor; he was convicted for defacing an edict; because his elder brother Bayan had merit, he was specially appointed.
s0300.idiomatic: Formerly Mazhaertai had been Shaanxi Branch Censorate attendant censor; he was convicted for defacing an edict; because his elder brother Bayan had merit, he was specially appointed.
